scriptData.label: @effect.name
Broken Head (Major)

description.label: Description
description.value:
The bullet goes in through your open mouth. It lacerates your tongue and soft palate before it exits behind the angle of your jaw in a spray of spittle and blood.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (3) and @Condition[Bleeding] (1). For healing purposes count it as a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.hCadFsTRvLN9faaY]{Broken Bone (Major)} except long-term effects are automatic as you’ll never be able to speak properly again.

No Extraction is necessary.
